_comment: Single source of truth for choice lists. Imported by the Flask validators and by the React forms so the two can never drift apart.

preIncubationCriteria.label: Business plan
preIncubationCriteria.description: Value proposition, market potential, industry attractiveness, potential social and strategic national impact, ethics.

preIncubationCriteria.label: Depth and width of market research

incubationCriteria.label: Target market
incubationCriteria.description: Addressable market is large/growing or a high-priced niche. Customer is well defined.

incubationCriteria.label: Problem or need
incubationCriteria.description: Problem is real; customer has significant pain or unfulfilled needs.

incubationCriteria.label: Solution
incubationCriteria.description: Better, faster, cheaper, simpler, higher quality, more efficient or more focused.

incubationCriteria.label: Team, board & advisors
incubationCriteria.description: Relevant industry knowledge, skills, leadership and key relationships.

incubationCriteria.label: Traction
incubationCriteria.description: Planned milestones, MVP built, market validation, user or revenue growth.

incubationCriteria.label: Competition vs competitive advantages
incubationCriteria.description: Direct vs indirect competition, barriers to entry, proprietary technology.

incubationCriteria.label: Revenue model
incubationCriteria.description: Clear revenue model, sales cycle, ARPU, LTV, recurring or one-time.

incubationCriteria.label: Strategy: key expenses / time efforts
incubationCriteria.description: Marketing strategy, cost to acquire and keep customers, partnerships.

incubationCriteria.label: Financial projections
incubationCriteria.description: Logical, reasonable margins, realistic penetration, shows scalability.

incubationCriteria.label: Exit opportunity
incubationCriteria.description: Acquirers identified, financial buyer, IPO, short vs long term exit.

incubationCriteria.label: Investment terms
incubationCriteria.description: Reasonable given stage, size of capital raise and prior investments.

incubationCriteria.label: Overall presentation / Q&A
incubationCriteria.description: Clear, convincing, engaging, handled Q&A effectively, honest.
